title: CHAPTER 045 - Safe handover to v3.7 project orchestrator
description: Safe static-file handover. Downloads prepublished v3.7 runner, project.json and handover helper, validates both PowerShell files and the 10-chapter manifest, starts the helper, then lets v3.6 finalize 045 before the helper switches ownership to v3.7.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent';$base='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3en4all/3en-command-runner/main/';$runner=$root+'/3en-agent-runner-v3.7.ps1';$project=$root+'/project.json';$helper=$root+'/handover-to-v3.7.ps1';Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ($base+'3en-agent-runner-v3.7.ps1') -OutFile $runner;Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ($base+'project.json') -OutFile $project;Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ($base+'handover-to-v3.7.ps1') -OutFile $helper;foreach($p in @($runner,$helper)){$tok=$null;$err=$null;[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($p,[ref]$tok,[ref]$err)|Out-Null;Write-Host ((Split-Path $p -Leaf)+'_SYNTAX_ERRORS='+@($err).Count);if(@($err).Count-ne0){throw ('syntax invalid '+$p)}};$pj=Get-Content -LiteralPath $project -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if($pj.projectId-ne'2026-09-09-stress-031-040'){throw 'projectId mismatch'};if(@($pj.chapters).Count-ne10){throw 'project chapter count != 10'};Write-Host 'PROJECT_MANIFEST=PASS_10_CHAPTERS';$hp=Start-Process -FilePath 'powershell.exe' -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$helper) -PassThru;Start-Sleep -Seconds 2;if($hp.HasExited){throw ('handover helper exited early code='+$hp.ExitCode)};Write-Host ('HANDOVER_HELPER_PID='+$hp.Id);Write-Host 'V37_HANDOVER_ARMED=TRUE'
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';foreach($p in @('C:/3EN-Agent/3en-agent-runner-v3.7.ps1','C:/3EN-Agent/project.json','C:/3EN-Agent/handover-to-v3.7.ps1')){if(-not(Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)){throw ('missing '+$p)}};$pj=Get-Content -LiteralPath 'C:/3EN-Agent/project.json' -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if(@($pj.chapters).Count-ne10){throw 'chapter count != 10'};$hp=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction Stop|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like '*handover-to-v3.7.ps1*'});Write-Host ('HANDOVER_HELPER_PROCESS_COUNT='+$hp.Count);if($hp.Count-lt1){throw 'handover helper not running'};Write-Host 'CHAPTER_045_TEST=PASS';Write-Host 'V37_NATIVE_PROJECT_READY=TRUE'
rollback: Write-Host 'Rollback: helper switches only after 045/SUCCESS. If 045 fails, v3.6 remains active. Backup preserved under C:/3EN-Agent/backups/045.'
